title: Wed 04 Nov 2026: Midterm results hit futures and the dollar, Bank of England hike expected, transaction reporting deadline Friday
summary: Early midterm results push US futures lower and the dollar down, while the FTSE 100 closes more than one percent weaker and oil swings on Gulf headlines. We preview tomorrow's Bank of England decision, where most economists expect a rise to four percent, then cover the FCA's transaction reporting deadline, the asset management reform, fund liquidity rules and the dates to diarise. In funds: UCITS and ETF launches, record European ETP assets and a data centre investment. Three COO action points and the diary for the week.
